senses.gloss:
गुप्त

GUPTA . A caste appellation. In ancient india appellations to the names were put to distinguish one caste from another. So ‘Śarmā’ was added to a brahmin name, ‘Varmā’ to a kṣatriya name ‘Gupta’ to a Vaiṣya name and ‘Dāsa’ to a śūdra name. Such appellations were considered to be a mark of nobility in those olden days. (Chapter 153, agni purāṇa).

गुप्तक

GUPTAKA . A prince of the country of sauvīra. He was a friend of the famous jayadratha. In the great battle he was killed by arjuna. (Śloka 27, Chapter 271, Vana Parva).
